requirements.text: The sample(s) of the ESA shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the submitted ESA samples and check that the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation are present, legible and indelible, for example after a rub test.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) conforming to a type approved under this Regulation shall have an approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. affixed to it, except that no marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and confirm an R10 approval mark per paragraph 5.3 is affixed.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark and verify a circle with letter E and the approving country's distinguishing number.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mark and verify '10R-' followed by the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.text: The electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review design and EMC test results showing compliance with R10 limits in normal operating modes.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.test_case: Verify the EMC test report covers radiated and conducted emissions and radiated and conducted immunity tests on the lamp ESA.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.test_case: Perform broadband radiated emission measurement per Annex 7 and confirm the test report references the Annex 7 method.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 30 to 400 MHz and verify all values are below the logarithmic 62-52 / 52-63 dB µV/m limit line of Appendix 6.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband emissions per Annex 7 from 400 to 1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 63 dB µV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values of broadband electromagnetic interference, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 7 broadband measurement results against the limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1; pass if all values are below the limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Perform narrowband radiated emission measurement per Annex 8 and confirm the test report references the Annex 8 method.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 from 30 to 400 MHz and verify all values are below the logarithmic 52-42 / 42-53 dB µV/m limit line of Appendix 7.

requirements.text: When measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limit in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.test_case: Measure narrowband emissions per Annex 8 from 400 to 1,000 MHz and verify all values are below 53 dB µV/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value of narrowband electromagnetic interference, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.test_case: Compare Annex 8 narrowband measurement results against the limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1; pass if all values are below the limits.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances on 12/24 V supply lines of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Perform conducted transient emission test per ISO 7637-2 / Annex 10 and verify pulse amplitudes against Table 1.

requirements.text: For positive polarity, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA shall be +75 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and +150 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Record positive transient pulses on the supply line per ISO 7637-2; pass if amplitude does not exceed +75 V (12 V) or +150 V (24 V).

requirements.text: For negative polarity, the maximum allowed pulse amplitude of transient conducted disturbances generated by the ESA shall be -100 V for vehicles with 12 V systems and -450 V for vehicles with 24 V systems as given in Table 1.
requirements.test_case: Record negative transient pulses on the supply line per ISO 7637-2; pass if amplitude does not exceed -100 V (12 V) or -450 V (24 V).

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Perform radiated immunity testing using one or more Annex 9 methods and confirm the method selection is documented in the test report.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.
requirements.test_case: Expose the lamp to the Table 2a levels for the chosen method (e.g. ALSE 30 V/m 80-2,000 MHz, 10 V/m 2-6 GHz; BCI 60 mA) over >90 % of the band and verify no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation such that test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band is as given in Table 2b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the applied test level never falls below the Table 2b minimum for the chosen method (e.g. ALSE 25 V/m below 2 GHz, 8 V/m above; BCI 50 mA) over the whole band, with no degradation of immunity related functions.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation by the method(s) as described in Annex 9.
requirements.test_case: Verify the immunity test report applies the Annex 9 method(s).

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 9 radiated immunity tests and monitor the lamp functions; pass if no degradation of performance of immunity related functions is observed.

requirements.text: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows transient immunity testing per ISO 16750-2 and ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 at the Table 3a/3b levels.

requirements.text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 1 at -75 V (12 V) / -450 V (24 V), 500 pulses; pass if FPSC III is met.

requirements.text: For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 2a at +37 V, 500 pulses; pass if FPSC I (immunity related functions) / III (others) is met.

requirements.text: For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 2b at +10 V (12 V) / +20 V (24 V), 10 pulses; pass if FPSC II (immunity related functions) / III (others) is met.

requirements.text: For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 3a at -112 V (12 V) / -150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related functions) / III (others) is met.

requirements.text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity as specified in Table 3b.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulse 3b at +75 V (12 V) / +150 V (24 V) for 1 h; pass if FPSC I (immunity related functions) / III (others) is met.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report evaluates the starting profile test against ISO 16750-1 functional status classes.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report evaluates pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b using ISO 7637-1 FPSC.

requirements.text: For the 12 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply starting profile level II, 10 pulses, on 12 V supply; pass if the required functional status class (B/D or C) is achieved.

requirements.text: For the 24 V system starting profile (ISO 16750-2, test level II, 10 pulses), an ESA that shall be operational during engine start phases shall reach functional status class B if it performs immunity-related functions and class D if it does not, and any other ESA shall reach class C, as given in Table 3a; the starting profile applies only to ESAs that may be installed in vehicles with an internal combustion engine started by a 12 V / 24 V starter motor.
requirements.test_case: Apply starting profile level II, 10 pulses, on 24 V supply; pass if the required functional status class (B/D or C) is achieved.

requirements.text: Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, in paragraph 7.
requirements.test_case: Test series-production samples against the paragraph 6 emission and immunity requirements; pass if every requirement met by the approved type is still met.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).
requirements.test_case: Measure broadband and narrowband emissions of a series ESA per Annexes 7 and 8; pass if levels do not exceed the paragraph 6.5.2.1/6.6.2.1 reference limits by more than 4 dB.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.
requirements.test_case: Expose a series ESA to radiated fields up to 80 % of the paragraph 6.8.2.1 reference limits per Annex 9; pass if no observable degradation of lamp function occurs.

requirements.text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses at paragraph 6.9.1 levels and measure conducted emissions per paragraph 6.7.1 on a series sample; pass if no degradation of immunity-related functions and emissions within limits.

requirements.text: In the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions per Annex 7 with 120 kHz bandwidth over 30-75 MHz and verify all levels are below E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 75-400 MHz and verify all levels are below E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) broadband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 63 (see paragraphs 6.5.2.1. and 7.10.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA broadband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 400-1,000 MHz and verify all levels are below 63 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 30-75 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions per Annex 8 with 120 kHz bandwidth over 30-75 MHz and verify all levels are below E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 75-400 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 75-400 MHz and verify all levels are below E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m.

requirements.text: In the 400-1,000 MHz frequency band, the electrical/electronic sub-assembly (ESA) narrowband reference limit E (dBµV/m) at frequency F (MHz) for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 53 (see paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation).
requirements.test_case: Measure ESA narrowband radiated emissions with 120 kHz bandwidth over 400-1,000 MHz and verify all levels are below 53 dBµV/m.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex, the test to measure broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the broadband radiated emission test report and confirm the test was performed according to CISPR 25 unless this Annex states otherwise.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report and setup records to confirm the lamp ESA was operated in normal operation mode, preferably with all functions at maximum load, during the broadband emission measurement.

requirements.text: For ESA other than involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the broadband emission measurement used the ALSE method of CISPR 25 Clause 6.4.

requirements.text: The limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp ESA broadband radiated emissions from 30 to 1,000 MHz in an ALSE or OATS; pass if emissions stay below the applicable limits over the whole range.

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used for the measurement of radiated emissions of the ESA, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied, the limits given in paragraphs 6.5. and 7.10. of this Regulation being for quasi-peak detectors.
requirements.test_case: Review the emission test report: if peak detection was used, confirm a 20 dB correction per CISPR 12 was applied before comparing with the quasi-peak limits.

requirements.text: If not otherwise stated in this Annex the test of the narrowband electromagnetic emissions of the ESA shall be performed according to CISPR 25.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report and confirm the narrowband emission test was set up and run per CISPR 25 unless Annex 8 states otherwise.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load, during the narrowband emission tests.
requirements.test_case: Check the test plan/report that the lamp was operated in normal mode with all functions (position, stop, reversing) energised at maximum load during measurement.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission test shall be performed according to ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4. of CISPR 25, except that as an alternative to an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4 may be used (see Figure 1 of the appendix to Annex 7).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report states the ALSE method of CISPR 25 paragraph 6.4, or a CISPR 16-1-4 compliant OATS, was used.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
requirements.test_case: Verify the emission scan covers 30 to 1,000 MHz and all readings are below the narrowband limits over that range.

requirements.text: The narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.test_case: Check the report that the average detector was used for the narrowband measurements.

requirements.text: The ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered: (a) Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2; (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3; (c) Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4; (d) Stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5; (e) Reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11.
requirements.test_case: Review the EMC test plan/report and confirm the selected ISO 11452 methods together cover the full 20 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions for testing the ESAs for immunity to electromagnetic radiation shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the immunity test report states frequency range and general test conditions per ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test conditions of the ESA during tests for immunity to electromagnetic radiation shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the ESA test conditions (temperature, supply voltage, etc.) comply with ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on.
requirements.test_case: Confirm from the test setup record that the lamp was powered (functions activated) during the immunity test.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report shows the rear position, stop and reversing functions were operated in normal operating mode during exposure.

requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be arranged as defined in this Annex unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
requirements.test_case: Compare the test setup photos/description with the arrangement defined in Annex 9 and the applicable ISO 11452 part.

requirements.text: The measurements for immunity of the ESA to electromagnetic radiation shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the test report covers 20 to 6,000 MHz with ISO 11452-1 frequency steps and no functional failure.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows AM 1 kHz, 80 % depth used from 20 to 400 MHz.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows PM2 (Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs) used from 2,700 to 3,100 MHz.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges, if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test report shows PM3 (Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs) used from 380 to 2,700 MHz and 3,100 to 6,000 MHz.

requirements.text: The frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.test_case: Check the step size and dwell time in the test report against ISO 11452-1 values.

requirements.text: The bulk current injection test of the ESA shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA; or BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA, except that as an alternative the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the following characteristics: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
requirements.test_case: Review the BCI test report and confirm ISO 11452-4 bench testing with the probe at 150 mm (substitution) or 900 mm (closed loop), or in-vehicle ISO 11451-4 testing with the probe at 150 mm (substitution).

requirements.text: The test method for transients shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.test_case: Perform the Annex 10 conducted transient immunity tests on the lamp ESA and confirm the required functional status is met.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Apply ISO 7637-2 pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b to the lamp supply lines and operationally connected lines (tail, stop, reverse feeds) and verify the required FPSC is achieved.

requirements.text: For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.
requirements.test_case: Apply the ISO 16750-2 starting profile to the lamp supply and operationally connected lines and verify the required functional status class is achieved.

requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.test_case: Measure transient conducted emissions per ISO 7637-2 on the lamp supply and operationally connected lines and confirm compliance with the Regulation limits.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, the lighting and light-signalling devices retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp installation on the vehicle and, after vibration exposure under normal conditions of use, verify the photometric, aim and positional characteristics still meet this Regulation.

requirements.text: It shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the fasteners/clips and mounting of the lamp to confirm the lamp cannot be displaced or misaimed without deliberate tool use.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp reference axis on the vehicle relative to the road bearing plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: The reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure the reference axis of each rear signalling function relative to the vehicle median longitudinal plane; pass if parallel within ±3°.

requirements.text: For the orientation of the reference axis of light-signalling devices, in each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
requirements.test_case: Check measured reference axis deviations in each direction; pass if within ±3°.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting of light-signalling devices laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.test_case: Compare the installed lamp against the manufacturer's fitting instructions; pass if all instructions are followed.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the height and orientation of the lamps shall be verified with the vehicle unladen and placed on a flat, horizontal surface, in the condition defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and, in the case where an AFS is installed, with the system in its neutral state.
requirements.test_case: Verify lamp height and orientation with the vehicle unladen on a flat horizontal surface per 2.3.10; pass if measured values meet installation limits.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.test_case: Measure the left and right lamp positions relative to the median longitudinal plane based on the exterior form; pass if symmetrical.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be symmetrical to one another in relation to the median longitudinal plane, this requirement is not valid with regard to the interior structure of the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Compare the external geometry of the left and right lamps; pass if mirror-symmetrical about the median longitudinal plane.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each function on left and right lamps; pass if both meet the same colour requirements.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare photometric measurements of left and right lamps for each function; pass if substantially identical.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the rear of the vehicle and only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo can be fitted on the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Count lamp-incorporated logos on the vehicle rear; pass if two lateral (one per side) or one central only.

requirements.text: In case of lamps incorporating a logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Inspect any logo in the lamp; pass if it is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify each function of the multi-function rear lamp individually for colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical connections; pass if all are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Measure each function's photometry and colour with all other functions switched OFF; pass if requirements are met.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Switch ON the rear position lamp and the reciprocally incorporated function together and measure chromaticity; pass if colour requirements of the other function are met.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be permitted to be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp design; pass if stop and direction-indicator functions do not share a common illuminating surface/light source arrangement.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Project the distinct parts and compute area ratio to the smallest circumscribing quadrilateral; pass if not less than 60 per cent (or alternative (b) met).

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the gap between facing edges of adjacent distinct parts perpendicular to the reference axis; pass if not more than 75 mm (or alternative (a) met).

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed, check from the front of the vehicle that no red light from the rear lamp is visible.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that where the (maximum and minimum) height above the ground clearly meets the requirements of the Regulation, the exact edges of any surface need not be determined.
requirements.test_case: Measure the highest and lowest points of each function's apparent surface above ground; pass if within the height limits of the Regulation.

requirements.text: For the purposes of reducing the geometric visibility angles, the position of a lamp with regard to height above the ground, shall be measured from the H plane.
requirements.test_case: When a reduced vertical visibility angle is claimed, measure lamp height from the H plane; pass if the height measured qualifies for the reduction.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Operate each lamp function continuously and monitor intensity, colour and apparent surface; confirm no intentional variation occurs while switched ON.

requirements.text: To verify paragraph 5.10.1., for the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Perform a geometric check per Annex 4 from Zone 1 in the transverse plane 25 m ahead of the vehicle and confirm no direct view of the red lamp's apparent surface.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the requirement of paragraph 5.10.4.1. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Where visibility is doubtful, check type-approval photometric data for red light emitted forward and confirm it does not exceed 0.25 cd per lamp including body influence.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously, except while one or more of the following conditions exist: (a) front and rear position lamps, as well as side-marker lamps when combined or reciprocally incorporated with said lamps, are switched ON as parking lamps; (b) side-marker lamps flash in conjunction with direction indicators; (c) daytime running lamps are switched ON; (d) front position lamps function is substituted under the provisions of paragraph 5.12.1.
requirements.test_case: Operate the vehicle light switch and confirm the rear position lamps switch ON and OFF only together with the front position lamps and rear registration plate lamp, outside the listed exceptions.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Switch the function ON and OFF and confirm all light sources of the interdependent lamp system activate and deactivate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the rear lamp and retro-reflector have no concealment device and are permanently exposed.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the reversing lamp light and verify it lies within the white colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the stop lamp light and verify it lies within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the rear position lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the chromaticity of the rear position lamp light and verify it lies within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The colour of the light reflected by the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure the colour of the retro-reflected light of the rear retro-reflector and verify it lies within the red colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and rear retro-reflectors fitted on the vehicle and verify against the numbers in the individual specifications.

requirements.text: Any lamp may be installed on movable components provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Review the installation and verify that the conditions of paragraphs 5.18., 5.19. and 5.20. are fulfilled for the lamp on the movable component.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, may be installed on movable components only if at all fixed positions of the movable components the lamps on the movable components meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Place the movable component in each fixed position and verify position, geometric visibility, colour and photometry of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector meet the requirements.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Place the movable component in non-normal positions with the lamps lit and verify no undue glare or discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Open and close the movable component repeatedly and measure the lamp position; pass if it returns to the manufacturer-specified position each time.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Place each movable component in each manufacturer-specified fixed position and measure the hidden portion of the apparent surface of the rear position lamp and retro-reflector; pass if not more than 50 per cent is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21 is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Move the movable component to the hiding position and check that additional compliant lamps switch ON; pass if they do.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be allowed, provided that the intensity of the all lamps mentioned above, when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Vary the controlling condition and measure intensities of the variable lamps; pass if all vary together in the same manner and similar proportion.

requirements.text: For rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., in the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop and position lamp intensities through the variation range; pass if the prescribed intensity ratio is maintained throughout transitions.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure the voltage at the lamp terminals on the vehicle in constant voltage operation; pass if it does not exceed the approved voltage.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, when the electrical system of the vehicle is in a constant voltage operating condition, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent, except that this shall not apply to devices which include an electronic light source control gear, or a variable intensity control being part of the device, or only light source(s) approved according to UN Regulation No. 128.
requirements.test_case: Measure terminal voltage of each lamp function on the vehicle in constant voltage operation; pass if not above 13.5 V (12 V system) or 28 V (24 V system) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp on the vehicle across its angles of geometric visibility and confirm no vehicle part obstructs light from any part of the apparent surface, other than obstacles already present at lamp type approval.

requirements.text: If measurements are taken closer to the lamp, the direction of observation shall be shifted parallel to achieve the same accuracy.
requirements.test_case: Check the geometric visibility measurement set-up: when measuring near the lamp, the observation direction is shifted parallel and results match observation from infinity.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Where the apparent surface is partly masked, measure photometry of the unmasked portion and confirm the values prescribed for device approval are still met.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Operate all interdependent lamps together and verify the geometric visibility angles are met.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify valid type approvals (e.g. UN R148 for position/stop/reversing functions, UN R150 for the retro-reflector) and the corresponding approval markings on the lamp.

requirements.text: In case of light-signalling lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, the lamp shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: If a logo is incorporated, check the lamp's UN R148 type approval covers the logo.

requirements.text: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only, except that this requirement does not concern light source modules, LED modules and non-replaceable light sources, except for when they are required to be approved by the applicable Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If replaceable light sources are used, verify the fitted light sources are approved under R37/R99/R128 in the categories stated in the lamp approval.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be mandatory on motor vehicles and on trailers of categories O2, O3 and O4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that at least one reversing lamp is fitted.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be mandatory and a second device shall be optional on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Count the reversing lamps installed on the M1 vehicle; pass if one or two are fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the reversing lamp for a valid UN R23 or UN R148 approval certificate and approval mark.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be at a height of not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the reversing lamp illuminating surface above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 1,200 mm.

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm the reversing lamp is mounted at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall be defined by angles α and β, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.: α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface of the reversing lamp is unobstructed over α = 15° up/5° down and β = 45° left/right (one device) or 45° outwards/30° inwards (two devices).

requirements.text: The reversing lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed reversing lamp and confirm its reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional vehicle test: the reversing lamp lights only with reverse gear engaged and propulsion system enabled.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall not switch ON or remain ON if either the reverse gear is not engaged or the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is not in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional vehicle test: disengage reverse gear or disable propulsion system and confirm the reversing lamp does not light or switches OFF.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for the reversing lamp shall be optional, except that a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review component regulation approval; if failure tell-tale is required, simulate reversing lamp failure and verify the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices of S1 or S2 categories shall be mandatory on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation and confirm that S1 or S2 category stop lamps are fitted.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval mark and certificate of the stop lamp for UN R7 (02 series or later) or UN R148 (00 series or later) approval.

requirements.text: All categories of vehicles shall be equipped with two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device.
requirements.test_case: Count the stop lamps on the vehicle and confirm two S1/S2 devices (one per side) and one S3/S4 device are present.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, for S1 or S2 categories devices the point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the stop lamp apparent surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height of the stop lamp apparent surface on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified by bodywork).

requirements.text: The S1 or S2 categories devices shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm the stop lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The horizontal angle of geometric visibility for S1 or S2 categories devices shall be 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, except that for the stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle (or by CAD) that the apparent surface of each stop lamp is unobstructed over 45° inward and outward (20° inward below H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The vertical angle of geometric visibility for S1 or S2 categories devices shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that (a) where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°; (b) where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above) the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle (or by CAD) that the stop lamp apparent surface is visible over 15° up and 15° down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The stop lamps shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and confirm the stop lamp reference axis points rearwards.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the service brake signal on the vehicle and confirm all stop lamps illuminate simultaneously.

requirements.text: The stop lamps need not function if the device, which starts and/or stops the propulsion system, is in a position that makes it impossible for the propulsion system to operate.
requirements.test_case: With the propulsion start/stop device in the off position, check the stop lamp behaviour is consistent with the permitted exemption, and with propulsion enabled confirm stop lamps function.

requirements.text: The tell-tale for the stop lamps shall be optional, however a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component regulation (UN R7/R148) for failure tell-tale requirements and, if required, simulate a stop lamp failure and confirm the tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps of R or R1 or R2 categories shall be mandatory.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and lamp approval to confirm rear position lamps of category R, R1 or R2 are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear position lamps on the vehicle (pass: two) and check their approval marks reference UN R7 02+ series or UN R148 00+ series.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the rear position lamp which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle, except that this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge; pass if not more than 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the lamp's apparent surface height above ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 350 mm and 1,500 mm (or 2,100 mm where justified by bodywork).

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the rear position lamps are located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle or CAD that the apparent surface remains visible from 45° inwards (20° below H if mounted under 750 mm) to 80° outwards.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle or CAD that the apparent surface remains visible from 15° above to 15° below the horizontal (5° below if mounted under 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the horizontal angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the horizontal visibility of each rear position lamp and confirm it covers 45° outwards to 45° inwards (20° inwards under H plane if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the vertical angle of geometric visibility of the rear position lamps shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vertical visibility of each rear position lamp and confirm 15° up and down (5° down if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, when the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, to be considered visible, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres.
requirements.test_case: At each limit angle, determine the unobstructed apparent surface by CAD/projection and confirm it is at least 12.5 cm².

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, when the alternative geometric visibility of paragraph 6.10.5.2. is applied, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded from the unobstructed view of the apparent surface of the rear position lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check that the 12.5 cm² visible-surface calculation excludes the area of the integrated retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and confirm the reference axis of the rear position lamp points rearwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections for rear position lamps shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator, the electrical connection of the rear position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.test_case: Review the wiring diagram and functional test on the vehicle to confirm rear position lamp switching complies with paragraph 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: Switch on the rear position lamps on the vehicle and confirm a closed-circuit tell-tale illuminates.

requirements.text: The tell-tale of the rear position lamps shall be combined with that of the front position lamps, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle that one tell-tale indicates both front and rear position lamps (outside DRL operation).

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check component approval; if failure indication is required, simulate lamp failure and confirm the failure tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be mandatory on motor vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the M1 vehicle installation and confirm that rear non-triangular retro-reflectors are fitted.

requirements.text: The number of rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular shall be two, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Count the rear non-triangular retro-reflectors on the vehicle (two required) and check that each carries a valid UN R3 (02 series or later) or UN R150 Class IA/IB approval mark.

requirements.text: In width, that point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the retro-reflector illuminating surface to the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; pass if ≤ 400 mm.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be at a height above the ground of not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the retro-reflector illuminating surface above the ground on the unladen vehicle; pass if between 250 mm and 900 mm (1,200 mm when grouped with rear lamps, 1,500 mm if bodywork prevents).

requirements.text: In length, the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle and confirm the retro-reflector is located at the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the retro-reflector illuminating surface is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 10° above and below horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1.), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check on the installed lamp that the retro-reflector is unobstructed 10° above and 10° below horizontal (5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installation and confirm the retro-reflector reference axis faces rearwards.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular may have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp drawings to confirm any overlap is only between the retro-reflector illuminating surface and apparent surfaces of rear lamps.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of geometric visibility of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Measure the geometric visibility of the installed retro-reflector illuminating surface and verify it is unobstructed over 30° inwards and 30° outwards horizontally.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of geometric visibility of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the installed mounting height and verify the illuminating surface is visible over 15° above and 15° below the horizontal (or 5° below if mounted below 750 mm).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors, non-triangular, shall be oriented rearwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the installed lamp and verify the retro-reflector reference axis faces rearwards.

requirements.text: When daytime running lamps are switched ON, the rear position lamps shall be switched ON, except that the rear position lamps and the other lamp(s) mentioned in paragraph 5.11. may be switched OFF when the daytime running lamps are switched ON, and may remain switched OFF as long as the ambient light conditions outside vehicle are above 7,000 lux (measured according to the requirements of Annex 13).
requirements.test_case: On the vehicle, switch the DRL ON automatically and verify the rear position lamps are ON, or are OFF only while the ambient light measured per Annex 13 is above 7,000 lux.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Trigger the emergency braking logic signal on the vehicle and verify that all fitted stop lamps operate simultaneously as the emergency stop signal.

requirements.text: The values measured for the distances of the position of lamps shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured mounting distances of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and retro-reflector on production vehicles with their individual installation specifications; pass if all are within limits.

requirements.text: The position of lamps, as defined in paragraph 2.1.6. of this Regulation, in width, in height and in length shall be checked in accordance with the general requirements set out in paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: During conformity of production, measure the installed rear lamp position in width, height and length per paragraphs 2.10.2., 2.10.3., 2.10.4., 2.3.3. and 5.4.; pass if the check is performed per these paragraphs.

requirements.text: The values measured for the angles of geometric visibility shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled, except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Measure the visibility angles of the rear position, stop and reversing lamps (e.g. 45° outboard for reversing) on production vehicles; pass if each meets its individual specification within the ±3° allowance.

requirements.text: The angles of geometric visibility of lamps shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On production vehicles, check the geometric visibility angles of each lamp function per paragraph 2.10.7.; pass if the check is performed accordingly.

requirements.text: The visibility of red light towards the front and of white light towards the rear shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 5.10. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: On production vehicles, verify per paragraph 5.10. that no red light from the rear lamp is visible from the front and that white light towards the rear comes only from permitted functions (reversing lamp); pass if compliant.

requirements.text: The lamps and tell-tales shall function in accordance with the provisions set out in paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. of this Regulation and with the individual specifications applicable to each lamp.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp functions and associated tell-tales on production vehicles; pass if switching behaviour complies with paragraphs 5.11. to 5.14. and each lamp's individual specifications.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be checked by switching on every lamp supplied by the electrical system of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: On production vehicles, switch on the rear position, stop and reversing functions via the vehicle electrical system; pass if each lamp is checked.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be such that the requirements set out in paragraphs 5.15. and 5.16. as well as in the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Compare the inspected presence, number, colour (red for position/stop, white for reversing), arrangement and category with paragraphs 5.15., 5.16. and individual lamp specifications; pass if all are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The presence, number, colour, arrangement and, where applicable, the category of lamps shall be checked by visual inspection of the lamps and their markings.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the installed rear lamps and their approval markings on production vehicles for presence, number, colour, arrangement and category; pass if inspection is performed.

requirements.text: When two or more lamps are part of the same unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, approval may be granted only if each of these lamps satisfy the provisions set out in this Regulation or in another Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify by test reports that each function in the rear lamp unit (position, stop, reversing, retro-reflector) meets its applicable regulation.

requirements.text: Lamps not satisfying the provisions of any of those Regulations shall not be part of such unit of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps.
requirements.test_case: Review the unit's function list and confirm no function lacks compliance evidence against an applicable regulation.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraphs 3.3.3.2. to 3.3.3.6.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp drawing/sample and verify a marking space large enough for the approval marking and other required markings is provided.

requirements.text: All markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the markings for legibility and perform a rub/durability test to confirm they are indelible.

requirements.text: With regard to the size of the approval marking the value for "a" shall be at least 5 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the approval marking dimension "a" on the lamp and verify it is at least 5 mm.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify a circle surrounding the letter E followed by the approving country number is present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number, being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify a four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval number is present.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the sequential number is located adjacent to the E approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the light signalling lamps prescribed in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the symbols for each approved function (e.g. R1/R2, S1/S2, AR) are present.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter 'R' and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify '148R' followed by the two-digit series of amendments is present.

requirements.text: On lamps which cannot be mounted on either side of the vehicle indiscriminately, the approval marking shall consist of a horizontal arrow showing in which position the lamp is to be mounted.
requirements.test_case: For a handed lamp, inspect the marking and verify a horizontal arrow indicating the mounting position is present.

requirements.text: The arrow shall be directed outwards from the vehicle in the case of rear position lamps.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp in its mounted orientation, verify the horizontal arrow points outwards from the vehicle.

requirements.text: On lamps which may be used as part of an assembly of two independent lamps, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "D" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the letter D appears to the right of the function symbol where applicable.

requirements.text: On lamps which are used as part of an interdependent lamps system, the approval marking shall consist of the additional letter "Y" to the right side of the symbol mentioned in paragraph 3.2.4.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify the letter Y appears to the right of the function symbol where applicable.

requirements.text: On lamps with reduced light distribution, see paragraph 1.1. of Annex 3, the approval marking shall consist of a vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment and directed downwards.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and verify a downward vertical arrow starting from a horizontal segment is present for reduced light distribution.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the approval marking.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and verify the approval marking is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and verify the applicant's trade name or mark is present.

requirements.text: Lamps shall, with the exception of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, bear a marking indicating the category or categories of light source(s) prescribed.
requirements.test_case: If light sources are replaceable, inspect the lamp and verify the prescribed light source category marking is present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with non-replaceable light sources, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp housing/lens for a legible marking of the rated voltage (e.g. 12V) or voltage range; pass if present.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps with an electronic light source control gear, the lamps shall bear marking of the rated voltage(s) (i.e. 6V, 12V or 24V) or the range of voltage.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a durable marking of the rated voltage (6V, 12V or 24V) or voltage range; pass if present when control gear is fitted.
