requirements.text: The approval marking shall be placed on an inner or outer part (transparent or not) of the lamp which is not designed to be separated from the transparent part of the lamp emitting the light.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking location on the drawing/sample; pass if on a part not designed to be separated from the light-emitting transparent part.

requirements.text: In any case the approval marking as well as the category or categories of LED substitute light source(s) prescribed, if any, shall be visible when the lamp is fitted on the vehicle or when a movable part such as the hood or boot lid or a door is opened.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp fitted on the vehicle, check visibility of the approval marking directly or with boot lid/door opened; pass if visible.

requirements.text: If the outer lens of a device is designed to be separated from the main body, the approval marking shall be placed on both, the detachable lens and the main body.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the detachable lens and main body; pass if both carry the approval marking.

requirements.text: The approval marking and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.3.2., 3.3.3.3., 3.3.3.4., 3.3.3.5. (b) and 3.3.3.6. shall be affixed on the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp sample; pass if the approval marking and the markings of 3.3.3.2, 3.3.3.3, 3.3.3.4, 3.3.3.5(b) and 3.3.3.6 (as applicable) are affixed on the lamp.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.5.1.1. and 3.3.5.1.2. are met.
requirements.test_case: Review marking concept; if a single approval mark is used, verify it carries the four to six-digit sequential number and meets 3.3.5.1.1 and 3.3.5.1.2.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: With the lamp installed on the vehicle, check that the single approval mark is visible; pass if visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed on grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Examine the construction; pass if no light-transmitting part can be removed without removing the approval mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark; pass if each is not smaller than the minimum size required for the smallest individual mark.

requirements.text: Each lamp submitted for approval shall conform to the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Review the test report; pass if the lamp sample meets all requirements of paragraphs 4 and 5.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5 "General specifications" and 6 "Individual specifications" (and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections) of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the lamp type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp design against sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 (M1 installation) in force at the application date and confirm all verifiable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each lamp and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the lamp is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of lamp type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that the R48 requirements pertinent to the rear position, stop and reversing lamps for category M1 that can be verified at lamp approval (e.g. geometric visibility) are verified and met.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so designed and constructed that in normal conditions of use, and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: After vibration exposure representative of normal use, verify the lamp still operates and meets the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics.

requirements.text: In the case of a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp, the rear position lamp and stop lamp functions shall either: (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance, a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure for the lamps.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the circuit design to confirm the reciprocally incorporated functions use multiple light sources, or confirm the lamp is declared for vehicles with a failure tell-tale.

requirements.text: Stop lamps, direction indicator lamps, and reversing lamps shall not incorporate a logo.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the stop lamp and reversing lamp apparent surfaces and confirm no logo is incorporated.

requirements.text: On request of the applicant, the internal structure of the optical components and/or the texture of the outer lens inside of the apparent surface of a lamp (function) may incorporate only one manufacturer logo build by transparent or non-transparent components provided that all requirements for the specific function of this Regulation are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for at most one logo inside the apparent surface and verify the function still meets all its photometric and colorimetric requirements.

requirements.text: When a lamp (function) incorporates a manufacturer logo, the enclosed light emitting surface of the logo (incorporating transparent and non-transparent components of the logo) of such a lamp in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 100 cm2.
requirements.test_case: Measure the enclosed logo light emitting surface projected in the reference axis direction and confirm it is ≤ 100 cm2.

requirements.text: In a single lamp containing more than one light source, a group of light sources, wired so that the failure of any one of them causes all of them to stop emitting light, shall be considered to be one light source.
requirements.test_case: Review the LED PCB circuit and confirm which LED groups fail together, treating each such group as one light source for failure assessment.

requirements.text: In case of failure of any one light source in a single lamp containing more than one light source, at least one of the following provisions shall apply: (a) The light intensity complies with the minimum intensity required in the pertinent table of standard light distribution as shown in Annex 3 and when all light sources are illuminated the maximum intensities shall not be exceeded; or (b) A signal for activation of a tell-tale indicating failure, as indicated in paragraphs 6.4.8., 6.7.8., 6.9.8, 6.10.8., 6.11.8., 6.12.8., 6.13.8. and 6.18.8. of UN Regulation No. 48, is produced.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of each light source (group) and measure the Annex 3 standard light distribution minima (with maxima respected with all sources lit), or verify that a failure tell-tale activation signal is produced.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a rear position lamp category R2 emitting more than the maximum value of category R1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure intensities; pass if steady-intensity R1 requirements are met automatically.

requirements.text: In case of failure of the variable intensity control of a stop lamp category S2 emitting more than the maximum value of category S1, requirements of steady luminous intensity of the respective category shall be fulfilled automatically.
requirements.test_case: Simulate failure of the variable intensity control and measure intensities; pass if steady-intensity S1 requirements are met automatically.

requirements.text: The lamp shall only be equipped with replaceable light source(s) approved according to UN Regulations Nos. 37, 99 and/or 128, provided that no restriction on the use is made at the time of application for type approval, and/or light source module(s) and/or non-replaceable light source(s).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp and BOM; pass if all light sources are UN R37/R99/R128 approved replaceable sources, light source modules or non-replaceable light sources.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the design of the lamp shall be such that the light source(s) can be fixed in no other position but the correct one.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to fit the light source in all orientations; pass if it can only be fixed in the correct position.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable UN approved light source(s), the light source(s) holder shall conform to the characteristics given in IEC Publication 60061, the holder data sheet relevant to the category of light source(s) prescribed applying.
requirements.test_case: Gauge the holder against the relevant IEC 60061 data sheet; pass if all dimensions conform.

requirements.text: Light Signalling Devices shall not generate radiated or power line disturbances, which cause a malfunction of other electric/electronic systems of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Perform EMC emission testing (e.g. per UN R10) on the lamp; pass if no disturbances causing malfunction of other vehicle systems occur.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it can only be fitted in the designated and correct position and can only be removed with the use of tool(s).
requirements.test_case: Attempt incorrect fitting and tool-less removal; pass if only correct fitting is possible and removal requires a tool.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that it is tamperproof.
requirements.test_case: Inspect module design for tamper resistance; pass if module cannot be opened or altered without destruction.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any replaceable UN approved light source.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to interchange the module with UN approved light sources; pass if not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), the design of the light source module(s) shall be such that, regardless of the use of tool(s), it is not interchangeable with any other replaceable light source module having different characteristics that is located in the same lamp housing.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to swap modules of different characteristics within the housing; pass if not possible.

requirements.text: In case of replaceable light source module(s), when the light source module is removed and replaced by another module provided by the applicant and bearing the same light source module identification code, the photometric requirements of device shall be met.
requirements.test_case: Replace the module with another of the same identification code and re-measure photometry; pass if requirements are met.

requirements.text: All measurements, photometric and colorimetric, shall be made with respect to the conditions of paragraphs 4.8.1.1. to 4.8.1.10. (Particulars of the methods of measurement to be used are given in Annex 3).
requirements.test_case: Review test report; pass if photometric and colorimetric measurements follow the stated conditions and Annex 3 methods.

requirements.text: In the case of a lamp equipped with light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s), all measurements shall be made with the light source(s) present in the lamp.
requirements.test_case: Check test report; pass if measurements were made with the lamp's own light sources fitted.

requirements.text: During photometric measurements, stray reflections shall be avoided by appropriate masking.
requirements.test_case: Review photometric setup; pass if appropriate masking prevents stray reflections.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensities shall be measured with the light source continuously lit.
requirements.test_case: Review photometric procedure; pass if intensities were measured with the light source continuously lit.

requirements.text: The limits of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of a light-signalling lamp shall be determined, except that in the case of category 5 and 6 direction indicators, the limits of the light emitting surface shall be determined, and this requirement shall not apply to rear-registration plate illuminating lamps.
requirements.test_case: Determine and document the apparent surface limits in the reference axis direction for each function; pass if recorded on the drawings/report.

requirements.text: Unless otherwise specified, the voltage supplied at the lamp for testing shall be either 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems).
requirements.test_case: Verify supply voltage at the lamp terminals during tests; pass if 6.75 V, 13.5 V or 28 V according to system voltage.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check test report; pass if the lamp was operated per the applicant's specification with its control gear.

requirements.text: In case of a lamp not controlled by an electronic light source control gear or a variable intensity control, in the case of light source module(s) or non-replaceable light source(s) the lamp shall be operated as specified by the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Check test report; pass if the lamp was operated as specified by the applicant.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, on the reference axis (HV), be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometer measurement at HV on both samples for each function; value ≥ minimum in paragraph 5 table.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, in no direction where the lamp is visible, exceed the maximum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Scan the full visible field on both samples per function; no measured value exceeds the paragraph 5 maximum.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, outside the reference axis, be not less than the product of the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5., by the percentage specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question, or be not less than the intensity value as specified in the pertinent light distribution figure reproduced in Annex 3 for each direction in question.
requirements.test_case: Measure each Annex 3 grid point on both samples; each value ≥ minimum × grid percentage or ≥ the specified grid value.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the intensity of light emitted by each of the two samples supplied shall, within the angles of geometric visibility defined in the tables in Annex 2, be not less than the minimum specified in the table of the pertinent function in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity across the Annex 2 geometric visibility field (e.g. to 45° outboard for reversing) on both samples; all values ≥ the paragraph 5 minimum.

requirements.text: The provisions of the relevant paragraphs of Annex 3 on local variations of intensity shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Check measured distribution against Annex 3 local-variation rules; no non-compliant local dips or peaks.

requirements.text: The variable intensity control shall not generate signals which cause luminous intensities outside the range specified in paragraph 5.
requirements.test_case: Exercise the variable intensity control over all conditions and verify intensities stay within the paragraph 5 range.

requirements.text: If a rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp producing either steady or variable luminous intensity, the ratio between the luminous intensities actually measured of the two lamps when turned on simultaneously at the intensity of the rear position lamp when turned on alone shall be at least 5:1 in the field delimited by the straight horizontal lines passing through ±5° V and the straight vertical lines passing through ±10° H of the light distribution table, except that if one or both of the two reciprocally incorporated lamps contain(s) more than one light source and is (are) considered as a single lamp, the values to be considered are those obtained with all sources in operation.
requirements.test_case: Measure combined (stop+position) and position-only intensities within ±5° V/±10° H; ratio ≥ 5:1 at each point.

requirements.text: Tests for compliance of the luminous intensities shall be carried out according to Annex 8.
requirements.test_case: Review photometric test report to confirm Annex 8 procedure was followed.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted shall be measured inside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3.
requirements.test_case: Spectroradiometric measurement within each function's Annex 3 grid (red for position/stop, white for reversing); chromaticity within limits.

requirements.text: Outside the field of the light distribution grid defined for the specific function in the relevant paragraph of Annex 3, no sharp variation of colour shall be observed.
requirements.test_case: Visually/colorimetrically inspect beyond the grid field; no abrupt colour change.

requirements.text: To check the colorimetric characteristics of the colour of the light emitted, the test procedure described in paragraph 4.8. shall be applied, except that for lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources, the colorimetric characteristics should be verified with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 4.8.
requirements.test_case: Confirm colour measurement used the paragraph 4.8 test conditions, with the fitted LEDs if non-replaceable.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of rear position lamps (R1, R2, MR) shall meet the requirements in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure both samples and verify every Table 4 value for the declared category is met.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R1, MR or RM1 (steady), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.7∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 8.5∙10^0 cd for a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement: on-axis ≥4 cd and ≤17 cd (8.5 cd if marked D), Figure A3-I distribution met, ≥0.05 cd throughout Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: A luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd shall be permitted for rear position lamps reciprocally incorporated with stop lamps below a plane forming an angle of 5° with and downward from the horizontal plane.
requirements.test_case: If reciprocally incorporated, verify measured intensity below the 5° downward plane does not exceed 60 cd.

requirements.text: For rear position lamps of category R2 or RM2 (variable), the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4∙10^0 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), the maximum luminous intensity shall be 4.2∙10^1 cd when used as a single lamp and 2.1∙10^1 cd for a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 5∙10^-2 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement: ≥4 cd and ≤42 cd (21 cd if marked D), Figure A3-I distribution met, ≥0.05 cd throughout Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility given in Table 4.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity over the Table A2-1 geometric visibility angles and verify ≥0.05 cd everywhere.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Simulate light source failures per paragraph 4.6 and verify the specified behaviour/intensity requirements are met.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the rear position lamps shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of the rear position lamp light and verify they lie within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples of the stop lamp supplied shall meet the requirements in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both stop lamp samples; all values must meet Table 7 for the declared category.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S1 (steady), the light emitted shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 2.60∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 1.30∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure on-axis and grid points per Figure A3-I and Table A2-1; verify ≥60 cd on axis, ≤260 cd (≤130 cd for 'D'), and ≥0.3 cd within geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: For a stop lamp of category S2 (variable), the light emitted shall have a minimum luminous intensity of 6.0∙10^1 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)), a maximum luminous intensity of 7.30∙10^2 cd when used as a single lamp or 3.65∙10^2 cd when used as a lamp marked "D" (Par. 3.3.2.5.2.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), the standard light distribution of Figure A3-I (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and a minimum luminous intensity of 3∙10^-1 cd (day) and 7∙10^-2 cd (night) within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure in day and night conditions per Figure A3-I and Table A2-1; verify ≥60 cd on axis, ≤730 cd (≤365 cd for 'D'), and ≥0.3 cd (day) / ≥0.07 cd (night) within geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the stop lamp within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as given in Table 7.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the boundaries of the geometric visibility angles of Table A2-1; values must not fall below the Table 7 minimum for the category.

requirements.text: The failure provisions for stop lamps shall be as in paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Review design and test failure behaviour of the stop lamp against paragraph 4.6; compliant if all paragraph 4.6 provisions are met.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the stop lamp shall be red.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of stop lamp light; chromaticity coordinates must lie within the red boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the reversing lamp shall meet the requirements in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both reversing lamp samples; all values comply with Table 10.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps of category AR, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 8.0∙101 cd (Par. 4.8.3.1. (a)) and the maximum luminous intensity shall be 3.00∙102 cd in or above the h-plane, 6.00∙102 cd below the h-plane, down to 5°D and 8.00∙103 cd below 5°D (Par. 4.8.3.1. (b)), with the standard light distribution of Figure A3-V (Par. 4.8.3.1. (c)), and no angles of geometric visibility requirement (N.A.) (Par. 4.8.3.1. (d)), as specified in Table 10.
requirements.test_case: Photometric test of the reversing lamp: minimum 80 cd on axis, maxima 300/600/8000 cd in the respective zones, distribution per Figure A3-V.

requirements.text: In the case where the reversing lamp is intended to be installed on a vehicle exclusively in a pair of devices, the photometric intensity may be verified only up to an angle of 30° inwards where a photometric value of at least 2.5∙101 cd shall be satisfied.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensity at 30° inwards; value is at least 25 cd.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the reversing lamp shall be white.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp emitted light; chromaticity coordinates within the white limits.

requirements.text: Outside of the projection area as defined by the individual specifications of UN Regulation No. 48, the light of the reversing lamp emitted directly towards the rear of the vehicle shall not exceed 5∙10-1 cd within the angular field where the vertical minimum angle φmin (in degrees) is φmin = arctan ((1-h)/10), h being the mounting height in m, and the vertical maximum angle φmax (in degrees) is φmax = φmin + 11.3.
requirements.test_case: Goniometer measurement between φmin and φmax for the declared mounting height; pass if no value exceeds 0.5 cd.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of the reversing lamp light; pass if the chromaticity coordinates are within the white limits.

requirements.text: The lamps shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: CoP audit comparing production lamps with the approved type documentation; pass if they conform.

requirements.text: For conformity of production, no measured value of the lamps shall deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometric measurement of production samples; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20% from the prescribed values.

requirements.text: For the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3, the measured values of the lamps shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12.
requirements.test_case: Compare measured minimum values in the Annex 2/3 fields with the Table 12 equivalents.

requirements.text: The front/rear position lamps (A, R1, R2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 80° outboard (20°/80°, reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) and minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below (15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm; 5°/15° for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm), as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric/visibility check of the rear position lamp apparent surface over 45° inboard/80° outboard horizontally and 15° up/15° down (or reduced angles per mounting height); pass if the lamp is visible throughout.

requirements.text: The stop lamps (S1, S2) shall have minimum horizontal angles of geometric visibility of 45° inboard / 45° outboard (20°/45°, reduced angles used only below the H-plane for lamps mounted with the H-plane below 750 mm) and minimum vertical angles of geometric visibility of 15° above / 15° below (15°/5° for lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of less than 750 mm; 5°/15° for optional lamps to be installed with the H-plane of the lamp at a mounting height of more than 2,100 mm), as specified in Table A2-1.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric/visibility check of the stop lamp apparent surface over 45° inboard/45° outboard horizontally and 15° up/15° down (or reduced angles per mounting height); pass if visible throughout.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, unless specified otherwise, the values shown in Figures A3-I to A3-XV give, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required, which shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits, except that in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (a) Front and rear direction indicators lamps; (b) Front and rear position lamps; (c) Front and rear end-outline marker lamps; (d) Parking lamps; (e) Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS; (f) Side marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement at the Figure A3 grid points; verify each measured intensity is at least the percentage of the required minimum, rounded down to three significant digits, with measurement limited to 5° downwards if the declared mounting height is ≤ 750 mm.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid, the light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensities between grid points within the light distribution field; pass if every intermediate direction meets at least the lowest minimum percentage on the surrounding grid lines.

requirements.text: In the case of reversing lamps, if visual examination of a lamp appears to reveal substantial local variations of intensity, a check shall be made to ensure that no intensity measured between two of the directions of measurement referred to above is below 50 per cent of the lower minimum intensity of the two prescribed for these directions of measurement.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect reversing lamp for local intensity variations; if present, measure between adjacent measurement directions and pass if no value is below 50 % of the lower of the two prescribed minima.

requirements.text: The standard light distribution for front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12 shall be as shown in Figure A3-I, the values shown giving, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8).
requirements.test_case: Measure rear position and stop lamp intensities at the Figure A3-I points; pass if each is at least the indicated percentage of the minimum required in Tables 3 and 7.

requirements.text: The standard light distribution for reversing lamps shall be as shown in Figure A3-V, giving the measuring points expressed in degrees of angle with the axis of reference and values of the minimum intensities of the light emitted, the values inside figure A3-V being in cd.
requirements.test_case: Measure reversing lamp intensities at the Figure A3-V angular points; pass if each value is at least the minimum in cd shown.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and geometric standpoint, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations within the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Compare production lamps dimensionally and mechanically with the approved type; pass if deviations stay within inevitable manufacturing deviations and the Regulation's requirements.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performances, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested, when testing photometric performances of any lamp chosen at random according to paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry of randomly chosen production lamps per paragraph 4.8; pass if results meet the paragraph 4.8 conformity tolerances.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates shall be complied with when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of each production lamp function under paragraph 4.9 conditions; pass if coordinates lie within the specified colour boundaries.

requirements.text: The conformity requirements shall be considered satisfied from a mechanical and a geometric standpoint, in accordance with the requirements of this Regulation, if any, if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.
requirements.test_case: Compare dimensions and geometry of production lamps with the approved drawings; pass if the differences do not exceed inevitable manufacturing deviations.

requirements.text: With respect to photometric performance, the conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if, when testing the photometric performances set forth in paragraph 4.8. of this Regulation of any lamp chosen at random, no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure the photometric performance per paragraph 4.8 on randomly chosen production lamps; pass if no measured value deviates from the values prescribed in paragraph 6.1.3.

requirements.text: The chromaticity coordinates of the lamps shall be complied when tested under conditions of paragraph 4.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates of production lamps under the conditions of paragraph 4.9; pass if within the prescribed colour limits.

requirements.text: The conformity of mass-produced lamps shall not be contested if the deviation of any specimen of samples A and B (all four lamps) is not more than 20 per cent.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric values of the four randomly selected lamps (samples A and B); pass if no specimen deviates by more than 20 per cent.

requirements.text: For reversing lamps and manoeuvring lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 minute and after 10 minutes of operation shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED reversing lamp, measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 10 min of operation and verify all test points are within the minimum and maximum requirements.

requirements.text: For all other lamps using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the LED rear position and stop lamp functions, measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 min (or photometric stability) and verify compliance with minimum and maximum values.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the front and rear position lamps is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance 4 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Where required by the light source technology, measure the rear position lamp at HV 4 s after switch ON and verify the scaled distribution complies.

requirements.text: Depending on the light source technology, the luminous intensity distribution of the stop lamp is, in addition to paragraph 1, checked for compliance 0.2 seconds after switch ON, with HV as reference coordinate, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Where required by the light source technology, measure the stop lamp at HV 0.2 s after switch ON and verify the scaled distribution complies.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm each function uses LED technology only and that the paragraph 1.2 measurements are compliant.

requirements.text: The approval number assigned to each type approved shall be marked on the device following the requirements of paragraph 3.3.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the retro-reflector to confirm that the assigned approval number is marked on it in line with paragraph 3.3.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (independent) shall be IA, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the retro-reflector and confirm the symbol IA is shown with dimension a ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: The symbol identifying the retro-reflector for motor vehicles (combined with other signal lamps which are not watertight) shall be IB, with a minimum "a" of 5 mm for examples of figures in Annex 10, as specified in paragraph 5.1.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the approval marking on the retro-reflector and confirm the symbol IB is shown with dimension a ≥ 5 mm.

requirements.text: Every device belonging to an approved type shall comprise a space of sufficient size for the Unique Identifier as referred to in the 1958 Agreement and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2. or, the approval marking and other markings as defined in paragraph 3.3.4.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the sample/drawing for a marking space of sufficient size for the UI or approval marking and the other markings of paragraph 3.3.4.2.

requirements.text: The markings shall be clearly legible and indelible.
requirements.test_case: Visually check legibility and perform a rub test on the markings; markings remain legible.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the approval mark, i.e. a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for a circle surrounding E followed by the approving country's distinguishing number.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the four to six-digit sequential number being part of the approval number prescribed in paragraph 3.2.3.2.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the four to six-digit sequential number matching the approval number.

requirements.text: The four to six-digit sequential number shall be placed close to the approval mark.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking and confirm the sequential number is located adjacent to the approval mark.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the symbols identifying the retro-reflective device prescribed in paragraph 3.2.5.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for the class symbol (IA or IB) as per paragraph 3.2.5.

requirements.text: The approval marking shall consist of the number of this Regulation followed by the letter “R” and the two digits indicating the series of amendments in force at the time of issue of the approval.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking for "150R" followed by the two-digit series of amendments in force at approval.

requirements.text: Where the approval marking as defined in paragraph 3.3.2. is replaced by the Unique Identifier, the Unique Identifier mark shall follow the format in the example shown in Figure I Unique Identifier (UI).
requirements.test_case: Inspect the marking on the retro-reflector and confirm the UI mark matches the Figure I format.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall bear the trade name or mark of the applicant.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the retro-reflector for the applicant's trade name or mark.

requirements.text: In case of a retro-reflector of Class IA, IIIA, IB, IIIB or IVA, the retro-reflective devices shall bear the word “TOP” inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface, if such an indication is necessary to determine without ambiguity the angle or angles of rotation prescribed by the manufacturer.
requirements.test_case: Check whether rotation is prescribed and, if so, verify the word TOP is inscribed horizontally on the highest part of the illuminating surface.

requirements.text: The approval marking or the Unique Identifier and the markings in paragraphs 3.3.4. shall be clearly legible on the retroreflective device.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the approval mark/UI, trade name and TOP marking for clear legibility on the device.

requirements.text: Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps have been found to comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed, and this marking may be located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided that the conditions of paragraphs 3.3.6.1.1. and 3.3.6.1.2. are met.
requirements.test_case: Review the marking concept and confirm a single mark is used only where all functions comply with their regulations.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, the single approval mark shall be visible after their installation.
requirements.test_case: Install the lamp on the vehicle or fixture and verify the single approval mark is visible.

requirements.text: Where a single approval mark is affixed to grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, no part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.
requirements.test_case: Review the design and confirm no light-transmitting part (e.g. lens, retro-reflector) can be removed without removing the mark.

requirements.text: The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
requirements.test_case: Measure the components of the single approval mark and compare with the minimum sizes required by each pertinent regulation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflectors approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraphs 4. and 5.
requirements.test_case: Test production samples against the requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5. and confirm conformity with the approved type.

requirements.text: The requirements contained in sections 5. "General specifications" and 6. "Individual specifications" and in the Annexes referenced in the said sections of UN Regulations Nos. 48, 53, 74 or 86, and their series of amendments in force at the time of application for the retro-reflecting device type approval shall apply to this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the retro-reflector against the applicable sections 5 and 6 of UN R48 for M1 vehicles; pass if all verifiable provisions are met.

requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.test_case: Check that R48 requirements pertinent to a rear retro-reflector on M1 vehicles that are verifiable at device approval are assessed and met.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect construction and verify photometric performance before and after the paragraph 5.1.7 tests; pass if the retro-reflector continues to function satisfactorily.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect samples for design or manufacturing defects; pass if none affecting operation or maintenance are found.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to dismantle the retro-reflector components by hand without tools; pass if they cannot be easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the outer surface and perform a cleaning trial; pass if dirt is easily removed.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough and any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.test_case: Visually and tactilely inspect the outer surface; pass if not rough and protuberances do not hinder cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the mounted assembly; pass if the inner (prism) surface of the retro-reflector is not accessible in normal use.

requirements.text: The combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter shall be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.test_case: Attempt to separate optical unit and filter under normal use conditions; pass if they cannot be separated.

requirements.text: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish shall not be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Inspect material and BOM of optical unit and filter; pass if colour is achieved in the mass and not by paint or varnish.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of retro-reflected light under Illuminant A; pass if x,y lie within the R48 red night-time colour limits.

requirements.text: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Verify the colour test setup uses Illuminant A, 1/3° divergence and β1=β2=0° (or Annex 4 angle if surface reflection occurs).

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.test_case: Measure retro-reflector shape and dimensions against Annex 5; pass if compliant.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: Measure CIL values and chromaticity per paragraphs 5.1.4 to 5.1.5; pass if all limits are met.

requirements.text: When tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.test_case: Perform the paragraph 5.1.7 physical/mechanical test sequence; pass if all requirements are met.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.test_case: After the group tests, measure night-time colour of each sample; chromaticity lies within the R48 red limits.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.test_case: After the group tests, measure RI of each sample; values are at or above the Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: The verification of the RI after undergoing the tests referred to in paragraph 5.1.3.1. shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.test_case: Check post-test RI measurement is made at 20' and β1 = β2 = 0° (or Annex 4 Part 1 positions); result meets Table 3.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.test_case: Review the approval documentation; one or more or a range of axes of reference corresponding to β1 = β2 = 0° is specified.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered.
requirements.test_case: Verify the illuminating surface used for photometry is bounded by the outermost optical parts and lies within a 200 mm diameter circle.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.test_case: Measure the illuminating surface area considered for photometry; it does not exceed 100 cm2.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.test_case: Goniometric RI measurement per Annex 4 Part 1 paragraph 3; all values are at or above Table 3 minima for red Class IA/IB.

requirements.text: For Class IA and IB red retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence α of 20', the RI values shall be equal to or greater than 3.00∙102 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.00∙102 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and 1.00∙102 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 20' divergence at the listed illumination angles; values ≥ 300, 200 and 100 mcd/lx respectively.

requirements.text: For Class IA and IB red retro-reflectors at an angle of divergence α of 1°30', the RI values shall be equal to or greater than 5∙100 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = 0°, β2 = 0°, 2.8∙100 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0° and 2.5∙100 mcd∙lx-1 at β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20° as specified in Table 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure RI at 1°30' divergence at the listed illumination angles; values ≥ 5, 2.8 and 2.5 mcd/lx respectively.

requirements.text: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 shall not be permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.test_case: Scan RI within the defined solid angle; no value falls below the corresponding Table 3 minima.

requirements.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.test_case: Confirm intended mounting height; if below 750 mm, verify RI values down to 5° downwards only and confirm compliance.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the reflected light of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Perform night-time colour measurement per paragraph 4.2.1 and record trichromatic coordinates.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the device shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity of reflected light; coordinates fall within the R48 night-time red limits.
